name: @pipeworx/mcp-virginia-code

tools.name: va_code_section
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Code of Virginia — Virginia state statutes — by citation. "Va. Code 18.2-32" is first and second degree murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does Virginia Code 18.2-32 say" or to check a Virginia statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "18.2-32" or "46.2-862". Title is the part before the dash.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-virginia-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the virginia-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
